# FLX-6104: a reserved word or the NULL literal used where it has no meaning

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

A keyword stands where a name or a value belongs: quote a column whose name is a keyword (`"end"`). NULL takes its type from a typed operand beside it, as in `x + NULL` or `CASE WHEN c THEN x ELSE NULL END`. It is never an operand of a comparison, BETWEEN or an IN list, where the test would always be FALSE: write `x IS NULL`, `x IS NOT NULL` or `a IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b`. Nor is it the operand of IS [NOT] NULL, a minus or ROUND, a bool (a NULL predicate counts as FALSE), a whole text, or every operand of a construct.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6104
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
